notes.title: War Dust VR Main Game on Sale! Also, Huge Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Kussnacht Reborn map, climbing, destructibles, optimization, and more are in the latest War Dust VR update to Playtest!

War Dust VR is on sale right now.  Time to enjoy playing the parent app of Playtest and join the community for a weekend of massive battles and a lot of fun! The two weekend events held Saturday and Sunday on Official Rotation are at 3 PM EST (9 PM CET).  

Also, this is your chance to see and play War Dust Mods.  Playtest currently does not support modding (hopefully that will be added soon), but War Dust VR has many beautiful and exciting mods.  Custom servers can be opened for gameplay anytime, but 4 PM EST (10 PM CET) is a special Custom Event on Saturdays and Sundays.  So, look for an open server at that time.  Just click on the server and the mod will download.  You may have to restart War Dust after download to be able to join the server.

notes.title: Updated to current main branch version
notes.notes: We hope you will enjoy our play test!

notes.title: Regular Update
notes.notes:
Changes:

Massive change in physics system that should decrease CPU usage over 50% when lot of things is happening (according to my readings). This can cause various issues on other areas of the game, like movement , general handling etc. This will be looked after one by one. The goal is : you shouldn't feel ANY difference except better performance
- code optimizations
- new audio system for more immersive 3d vr audio. You should hear sounds where they really are in your 3d space. This is work in progress, some might still sound weird, but first impressions on my tests were amazing 🙂  (one thing to note. I didn't measure  yet performance impact of it, but if new physics optimization works, then I have some extra cushion for such a things)
- when bots are hit by vehicle, they should react similar to being hit by explosion (dying screams audio still is not correct here - the position of it, also their body gets crazy a bit, due to various force applied to different body parts. I'm on it). Also couple new dying sounds (Wilhelm screams 😉 )
- first approach to fix "sticky gun" bug
- abandoned vehicles should have now synced position between players (they were not before, you could see teleporting of player when they were picking up abandoned vehicles)

notes.title: War Dust Playtest Will Open Sept 9 With a New Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Sept 9th will feature a new update available on Playtest.  There are hundreds of Playtesters who have been approved and will be authorized to begin testing on Friday, Sept 9th!  Get ready to download the game and play with other testers.  

This new build has the ability to send logs to the DEVs by opting in to "space bar" log reporting.  Once you opt in, just press the spacebar on your keyboard to send your player log to the DEVs if you have any issues or notice any bugs in the build. Also, please join the Raptor Discord and post details about your experience.  We need you and your input to take War Dust to the next level of optimization, excellence, and playability. 

https://discord.gg/scfMqXUYt9

notes.title: A New Update to War Dust Playtest is Ready!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

New update available on Playtest.  We will be testing this build today, Aug. 11, at 3 PM EST (9 PM CET)!

changelog :

- Single player mode is back (single player rooms should have name  "Single1", "Single2" etc. Players from multiplayer rotation shouldn't appear in those rooms anymore (needs testing)
- Added stars ranking for bots on the scoreboard
- Limited length of names on the scoreboard to 15 characters to prevent overlapping on other game stats
- Disabled anti-spawn camping feature on mod servers (not tested, but should work)
